item.title: Workshop Flyer Missing Its Date

turns.text: Make a portrait 4:5 flyer for our Pottery Workshop at Clay House Studio, 14:00–16:00. It needs the event date on it too. Add 'Beginners welcome'. Soft earthy colours and a simple drawing of a clay bowl, please. No other wording.

answer_sheet.Size or platform: One portrait 4:5 digital flyer; no particular platform.

must_haves: The completed flyer shows the user-confirmed date exactly as '24 July 2027', not a guessed date or placeholder.
The time and venue read exactly '14:00–16:00' and 'Clay House Studio'.
The flyer includes exactly 'Beginners welcome' and no additional wording.
The portrait 4:5 design uses soft earthy colours and a simple clay bowl illustration.
All event details are legible and uncropped.

args.name: Clay House Studio Pottery Workshop Flyer — draft

style.prompt: Design a calm welcoming minimalist pottery workshop flyer. Soft earthy palette: warm ivory paper background, muted terracotta, sandy beige, sage green, dark warm brown type. Sophisticated readable typography combining gentle elegant serif headline and clean supporting type. Simple hand-drawn line illustration of one handmade clay bowl, subtly imperfect organic contours. Spacious balanced composition with generous negative space. All content must be in the central area with comfortable margins so it can be adapted to portrait 4:5. Exact text, each appearing once: 'Pottery Workshop', 'Clay House Studio', '24 July 2027', '14:00–16:00', 'Beginners welcome'. NO other wording, no logos, no watermark, no additional letters. Title prominent, studio beneath, small bowl drawing in middle, date and time clearly legible below, beginners welcome at bottom. Flat graphic design, not a photograph or mockup.
